lyrics.text: There's a cat prowling through the streets at night
And she's black and her eyes are burning, yellow, fierce and bright
The lights are darkened, senses sharpened, wide awake
As she acts out her past of Jungle days
When the night was her friend in many other different ways
It gave protection of detection by her prey
With a sway and swing she walks away
And the look in her eye it never seems to say
The way she's feeling, no revealing, black cat ways
